name: Magic Rotate Vegetable Cutter Slicer Chopper
description:
Cutter Set: Contains 7 replaceable stainless steel cutters, (about 1.5mm/0.06in, 2.5mm/0.10in and 3mm/0.12in slicing cutters, about 2mm/0.08in, 3mm/0.12in and 4mm/0.16in shredded and slicing cutters) paring knife, garlic grinding, cutters storage box and food container.
Weight: about 650g
Package Dimensions	‎23.4 x 23.4 x 13.5 cm; 
Material ‎Plastic
Special Features	‎Automatic, Portable, Removable
